newsitem.title: EGYPT: Sparks in canal panic Egyptian villagers.
newsitem.headline: Sparks in canal panic Egyptian villagers.

text.p: Sparks, bubbles and puffs of smoke on an irrigation canal in the Nile Delta caused consternation for three days this week, the Egyptian government newspaper al-Ahram said on Friday.

Some local people thought a volcano was about to erupt and ran to the village chief to say the canal had caught fire. Police sealed off the area and called in experts to investigate the phenomenon, which waned and disappeared by Wednesday morning.

Some villagers suspected schoolchildren were throwing in chemicals from chemistry lessons but al-Ahram said the most likely cause was biogas from an underwater pipe discharging fermented animal dung into the canal from a nearby tank.
The sparks and bubbles began to disappear soon after the tank was removed and the pipes dismantled, it said.
